messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

A direct Aerospace / Defense use-case source connecting the customer/application to Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer, because current evidence only separately shows “Aerospace & Defense Test” and raw equipment labels “Signal Generator” / “Signal Analyzer” [37][39].
Official R&S configuration and specification evidence for the exact proposed generator/analyzer setup, because the SMW200A specs/config guide are stated as sources for RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data, ordering information, options, mandatory configuration, compatibility, and service notes [3].
Exact R&S SMW200A frequency/baseband evidence, because SMW200A RF path A covers 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B covers to 44 GHz, and the instrument can scale from single-path vector signal generator to multichannel MIMO receiver tester [1].
Exact R&S FSW analyzer frequency and bandwidth evidence, because FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer family covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz, extendable to 90 GHz with FSW-B90G, and its analysis-bandwidth options are explicitly listed with applicability and limits [5][6].
Application-level evidence tying the R&S generator/analyzer pair to the aerospace/satellite measurement, because R&S FSW with R&S SMW200A is stated to measure absolute and relative group delay of satellite transponders, frequency converters, and other components [27].
Competitor official datasheets or configuration guides for the same use case and metrics, because the Starlink equipment mapping lists R&S FSW / SMW200A alongside Keysight N9040B UXA / E8257D PSG but says formal frequency range, POI, power uncertainty, option needs, and order numbers must be checked in product datasheets [18][20].
Independent or official competitor evidence, not only internal battle-card positioning, because the Anritsu battle-card page says it does not cite Anritsu official documents or third-party market data [12].
Amarisoft page is described as sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [36].
Qualification/test-plan evidence for Aerospace / Defense standards or environments, because the DO-160 page cannot be used to infer complete categories, limits, waveforms, setups, or pass/fail criteria [17].
Calibration, uncertainty, and environmental setup evidence if claiming measurement accuracy in TVAC or satellite payload qualification, because the TVAC page says cable/adaptor/switch drift and recalibration affect measurement accuracy, while another page says it lacks chamber conditions, calibration interval, uncertainty budget, and qualification-certificate status [30][29].

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › Signal routing and baseband main module
| Code | Name / description | Order No. | 原文說明 / 限制 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `R&S®SMW-B13` | Signal routing and baseband main module，one I/Q path to RF section | `1413.2807.02` | Standard baseband section；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13T` | Signal routing and baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.3003.02` | Standard baseband section；若要安裝 RF path B 需 `B13T` 或 `B13XT`；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13XT` | Wideband baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.8005.02` | Wideband baseband section；RF modulation bandwidth up to `2 GHz`。 |

- Standard baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13T`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `160 MHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B10` standard baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B14` fading simulator。
- Wideband baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13XT`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B9` / `R&S®SMW-B9F` wideband baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B15` fading simulator and signal processor。

Keysight › R&S 2026-02-26 battle card 中的 Keysight 描述
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Keysight 被描述為 large US-based test & measurement vendor，總部位於 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**。
- 來源說 Keysight 在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具 strong market presence。
- 來源說 Keysight 在美國與 key semiconductor accounts 很強，並宣稱有 broad ecosystem partnerships：24/25 top tech companies、14/15 operators、25/25 semiconductor companies。
- 來源列出 Keysight portfolio：[[Keysight UXM]] 5G Wireless Test Platforms（[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]）、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源說 Keysight UXM portfolio fragmented across multiple hardware SKUs，每個 SKU 有不同 bandwidth、RF ports、Wi-Fi、Rel-17/18 capabilities。
- 來源說 Keysight software model 分散於 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、Nemo、WLAN tools 與 UXM-specific feature options，並稱 no unified automation environment。
- 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered [[KeysightCare]] model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，另有 optional warranty and calibration assurance plan。

Anritsu
[[Anritsu]] 是一間日本 test & measurement vendor；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中被描述為 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 的競品供應商。

Anritsu › Battle card 中的公司輪廓
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Headquarters：Kanagawa, Japan。
- Company size：約 4,000+ employees global。
- Market positioning：source 稱其在 Japan T&M market share 為 #1，但 global footprint 較弱。
- Strengths：good LTE/eCall signaling（[[Anritsu MD8475B]]）、solid RF heritage、strong Japanese operator relationships。
- Support model：traditional hardware service；source 評為 software ecosystem 較弱、cloud capabilities limited，且 TestDeck 是唯一 DX tool。

以上為 R&S internal battle card 對競品的描述；來源未引用 Anritsu 官方文件或第三方市場資料。

Anritsu › 來源列出的產品組合

|---|---|---|
| [[Anritsu MT8000A]] | 5G NR FR1 / FR2 / FR3 | source 稱需 separate RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes；未列 Anritsu datasheet 版次 |
| [[Anritsu MD8475B]] | LTE / IMS / eCall | source 稱是 Anritsu strength之一 |
| [[Anritsu MT8821C]] | LTE / LTE-A / 3G / 2G RF | source 稱 LTE RF requires MT8821C |
| [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | Wi-Fi | source 稱 MT8000A 無 WLAN signaling，Wi-Fi 需 separate tester |
| [[Anritsu MT8852B]] | Bluetooth | source 僅列入 portfolio，未展開規格 |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[RTCA DO-160]] 正式標準摘要；只保存 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 的簡報文字。
- 不得由本頁推論 DO-160G / DO-160 任何 section 的完整 category、limit、waveform、test setup 或 pass / fail criteria。
- 來源把 DO-160 放在 military / aviation drone example 中，但未說明特定 drone、eVTOL 或 avionics equipment 的 qualification plan。

Starlink User Terminal › Recommended RF test equipment
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 推薦：

- Spectrum analyzer：[[R&S FSW]]（43.5 GHz、POI 0.46 µs）、Keysight N9040B UXA。
- Signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]（100 kHz–31.8 GHz）、Keysight E8257D PSG。
- Power meter：[[R&S NRX]] with NRP33S（±2.5 dB abs）、Bird 43 wattmeter。
- VNA：Keysight PNA-X（67 GHz）、[[R&S ZNA]] for array calibration。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法一：R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A multi-carrier group delay measurement
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 與 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 可用於快速、直接量測 satellite transponders、frequency converters 與 other components 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 典型 setup 元件
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 的 TVAC test setup 可包含：

- signal generator
- RF switching matrix
- signal analyzer
- network analyzer
- multimeter
- DC power system
- laptop / PC remote operation
- test interface
- TVAC
- satellite or satellite components
- bulkhead connector interface

來源標示 TVAC setup 中距離為 10 m to 25 m。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 使用限制
- 來源未提供 [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]] 的完整 datasheet、order number、完整 environmental specification 或 ESA norms 條文。
- 來源未說明 TVAC chamber 的 pressure、temperature profile、dwell time、calibration interval 或 uncertainty budget。
- 本頁只記錄 2022 application brochure 的 solution-level 說法，不可視為產品 qualification certificate。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

A direct Aerospace / Defense use-case source connecting the customer/application to Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer, because current evidence only separately shows “Aerospace & Defense Test” and raw equipment labels “Signal Generator” / “Signal Analyzer” [37][39].
Official R&S configuration and specification evidence for the exact proposed generator/analyzer setup, because the SMW200A specs/config guide are stated as sources for RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data, ordering information, options, mandatory configuration, compatibility, and service notes [3].
Exact R&S SMW200A frequency/baseband evidence, because SMW200A RF path A covers 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B covers to 44 GHz, and the instrument can scale from single-path vector signal generator to multichannel MIMO receiver tester [1].
Exact R&S FSW analyzer frequency and bandwidth evidence, because FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer family covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz, extendable to 90 GHz with FSW-B90G, and its analysis-bandwidth options are explicitly listed with applicability and limits [5][6].
Application-level evidence tying the R&S generator/analyzer pair to the aerospace/satellite measurement, because R&S FSW with R&S SMW200A is stated to measure absolute and relative group delay of satellite transponders, frequency converters, and other components [27].
Competitor official datasheets or configuration guides for the same use case and metrics, because the Starlink equipment mapping lists R&S FSW / SMW200A alongside Keysight N9040B UXA / E8257D PSG but says formal frequency range, POI, power uncertainty, option needs, and order numbers must be checked in product datasheets [18][20].
Independent or official competitor evidence, not only internal battle-card positioning, because the Anritsu battle-card page says it does not cite Anritsu official documents or third-party market data [12].
Amarisoft page is described as sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [36].
Qualification/test-plan evidence for Aerospace / Defense standards or environments, because the DO-160 page cannot be used to infer complete categories, limits, waveforms, setups, or pass/fail criteria [17].
Calibration, uncertainty, and environmental setup evidence if claiming measurement accuracy in TVAC or satellite payload qualification, because the TVAC page says cable/adaptor/switch drift and recalibration affect measurement accuracy, while another page says it lacks chamber conditions, calibration interval, uncertainty budget, and qualification-certificate status [30][29].
